zh.text: @garyblack00 報告美股盤前反彈（標普 +0.7%，納指 +1.2%），因 Nvidia 強勁 Q4 及 2027 指引確認穩健 AI 需求，$NVDA 盤前漲 3.1% 至 $160，同業 $AMD $AVGO $MU $DELL 漲 2-3%。Anthropic（$ANT）今晚將定價史上最大 IPO，募資達 900 億美元，估值可能達 1.4 兆美元。布倫特原油跌 1.1% 至 $92，10 年期收益率降至 5.09%，市場定價 12 月聯儲加息概率超 100%。標普 2026 年 EPS $369（同比 +33%）隱含 19.9 倍市盈率。

en.text: @garyblack00 reports US stocks rebounded pre-market (SPX +0.7%, NDX +1.2%) on Nvidia’s strong Q4 and 2027 guidance affirming robust AI demand, $NVDA up 3.1% pre-mkt to $160, peers $AMD $AVGO $MU $DELL 2-3% higher. zh.text: T. Rowe堅持看淡國債的押注，推動了出色的2026年。自2026年初押注英國金邊債券並做空美國國債，為T. Rowe Price的Scott Solomon帶來回報，他不急於平倉這些押注。他共同管理的8億美元Dynamic Global Bond Fund今年迄今上漲約5%，跑贏97%同行，有望創2020年以來最佳年度表現。支撑這一回報的基本信念是：美國經濟將繼續超越其他經濟體，給國債帶來壓力。「我們堅持美國強勁增長、世界其他地區增長不那麼好的觀點，」Solomon說。

en.text: T. Rowe Sticks to Bearish Treasuries Bet That Fueled Banner 2026. Betting on UK gilts and against US Treasuries since early 2026 is paying off for T. Rowe Price’s Scott Solomon, who isn’t in any hurry to unwind those wagers. His co-managed $800 million Dynamic Global Bond Fund is up around 5% so far this year, beating 97% of peers and on track for its best annual performance since 2020. Underpinning that return was a basic conviction: That the US economy would keep outpacing other economies, putting pressure on Treasuries. “We’ve stuck with the view of strong growth in the US and not quite as good growth in the rest of the world,” Solomon said.
